Episode 254. The Egos of the Sun God (6)
Thud!
The companions gathered around the fallen Dante. Solar energy flowing from Focal's hand gently lifted Dante up as if it were an arm.
Even at that moment, Dante had not let go of the sword inherited from Ron, Rashid.
[It is a miracle. That this child has held on until now.]
Focal said as she examined Dante.

[When I first created this place, I realized for the first time what a miracle was. The creatures under the sea were born by chance when I made the sea, and the same was true for the creatures in the sky and the creatures on the land. I only created this world; I did not decide all its laws and orders on my own.]
Dante was covered in wounds so deep that his bones and organs were visible, but after receiving Focal's touch, his breathing was rapidly stabilizing.
[Causality and coincidence that even I cannot explain accumulate... and finally reach inevitability. Whether the result is beautiful or not. This child was fated not to die here today.]
Soon, Focal raised her head.

It was to gaze upon her foolish brothers and the mortals. The Tower of Story, incomparably massive compared to her own body, was floating as if pressing down on the sky, and Kragos, having lost his leisurely demeanor, looked tense.

[However, will such a miracle be permitted for you? Zipple, you are... ruining the world. You want a world where you can decide everything according to your will, down to a single pebble, down to a single snowflake. That cannot be called a miracle. It cannot be called a completed world. It is merely endless darkness. A darkness where all possibilities are closed...]
Slosh, slosh, chwaaaaaa...!
As Focal's eyes shone, the golden sea that had formed in the area began to surge.
Every single drop of water that formed that sea was made of humans, life, and what they had built. Beings full of the miracles that Focal loved, trampled and transformed by a twisted power.
That fact was enraging Focal. Every living thing and object on the battlefield was distorting in reaction to that anger.
Only Jin and his companions could breathe comfortably. Beyond that, they even felt a sensation of their entire bodies becoming lighter, as if wrapped in wind. Focal's power was imbuing them.
The pain and guilt of a friend's death vanished, the hand holding the sword was endlessly firm, and the gaze upon the enemy was terrifyingly sharp.
“You've chosen your grave well, Kelliark Zipple. Today, you will surely die in this place. And Kragos... you should give up the thought of ending this easily."
Hwaruk...!

A blue flame erupted on Bradamante's blade. The Secret Technique of the Magic Sword, Eternal Flame. As the phoenix Tess broke through the summoning gate and revealed her form, the members of the Zipple could not help but recall the nightmare of their last battle.
The reason Jin was certain of his enemies', especially Kelliark's, death was different.

It was because he could not escape. The Tower of Story had been continuously attempting spatial jumps and reality manipulation since the moment Focal appeared, but the Origin Stone could not handle the solar energy that had spread in all directions.
Nothing was being calculated. Even the creation of troops was not happening. The solar energies of Focal, Kragos, and Malugia were severely degrading the function of the Origin Stone.
“Huuuu...”
Grit!
In the central part of the Tower of Story, Kelliark gritted his teeth in anger. From between his clenched teeth and lips, a sense of futility mixed with anger was leaking out like a sigh.
-[That is the price for your unrestrained words. From now on, I will go to find another self of mine, Kragos. After I awaken him, I will fall asleep again.]
-After you awaken Kragos, what should I do?
-[Do whatever you wish. For I have chosen you.]
-That is a truly pleasing answer...

-[You need only keep one thing in mind. That in the end, what awaits you all is only the apocalypse. In the end, everyone will die and disappear, and not even a trace will remain. Not even a single speck of dust blowing in the wind.]
The conversation he had with Malugia just a short while ago came to mind.
“To do as I wish... was this what you meant...”
He had been deceived.
He felt that he had been thoroughly played by Malugia. She had spoken as if she would help Kelliark perform his sword dance to the very end, but it was nothing.
“Kelliark my friend, is the situation that bad? W-will Malugia appear and help us?”
“That being must have foreseen this entire situation. So she is likely deliberately excluding her own power that dwells in the Origin Stone right now.”
“Hah? For what purpose? She spoke as if she was going to use us like a useful servant from now on!?”
Kelliark caressed the scar that Malugia had left on his neck and was lost in thought for a few seconds.
He was able to reach a conclusion quickly.
-[First, there is a need to close the numerous worlds that have branched off from you. Those numerous dregs that were created when you manipulated history a thousand years ago.]

'Whatever she was plotting using me, using the Zipple, whatever method she was planning to use... Malugia only wants one thing. That being intends to use me as a consumable to close the other dimensions.'
It felt as if the scar was choking him.
From the moment that scar was made, Kelliark's life was, in fact, completely Malugia's possession. Right now, Malugia was simply exercising her right as the owner to use that life.
“Damn it, but that Kragos fellow will help us, right? It seems he's hostile with that side anyway, ugh... still, this is difficult. Difficult.”
He could see no way out.

Even the dull Ragal could intuit that fact. If the Origin Stone was not functioning properly, the difference in military strength between the current Vamel Alliance and the Zipple was not on a level that could even be compared.

The Tower of Story, which prided itself on being the strongest in the sky, was nothing but a giant flying structure without the Origin Stone, and the mages on board could not be a variable at this point. The Spectre Corps, the Ghost Corps, the Demon Spirit Corps, all had records of being defeated by the Vamel Alliance numerous times in the past.
It was the same when comparing Genesis-Knight-level combatants; the Zipple only had Kelliark. It was impossible for him to face the enraged warriors of the coalition on his own.

Furthermore, he could not even threaten them on the pretext of mass slaughter as the Zipple had done until now. The many people they could have taken hostage were already flowing on the lands of the Empire as golden water.
“...It is time to struggle desperately, Ragal.”
Like a wave crashing in, Jin's Eternal Flame was continuously approaching beyond the central bridge. Every time he blinked, it came closer, like a nightmare.
Before long, that fire would incinerate the Tower of Story and engulf Kelliark. Then, it would burn away both his body and soul without a trace.
“Ugh, is that all we have.”
“Even if it ends, I cannot let it end so meaninglessly. We have no choice but to execute whatever we can. Ragal, you first, destroy Elona Zipple's body.”
Since capturing Elona, Ragal had been injecting her body with poison every day under Kelliark's orders.
At that time, they did not know about things like the egos of the Sun God or the truth of the multiple worlds, so it was a measure to prepare for the case of Elona rampaging in the future.

But now, the intention was to ruin the body so that Malugia could not use it. It didn't seem likely that Ragal's poison would work against the overwhelming power of the Sun God, but this was not the time to consider such things.
Because it was the end anyway. Unless the miracle that had always followed Jin were to occur, not a single member of the Zipple could leave this place alive.
“Got it.”
“Vassals of Zipple, listen. Due to an unexpected intrusion, we must now begin our final battle. Tear the enemies apart. So that even if we die, the enemies too cannot advance further.”
Chwaaaaaak-! Kdeudeudeuk!
The moment Kelliark finished speaking, the front of the bridge collapsed, and blue flames poured into the central interior of the Tower of Story.
That moment seemed like a slow-motion scene to Kelliark.
He didn't know when, how, or with what it had become so massive... the deep and ferocious eyes of the Runcandel youngest were about to swallow him whole.
“Kelliark, for someone of your stature, you finally have the face of a leader of a great power meeting his end. Yes, you must have felt it. The fact that today is finally the end.”
Kelliark did not answer and raised his staff to block his sword. The moment the sword and staff clashed, the sight of a part of the central area separating along with the Origin Stone followed.
Jin did not become impatient watching the Origin Stone instantly fall and move away from the tower. There was nowhere for them to run anyway, and his companions were outside.
“What does it matter if it is the end? The apocalypse has come anyway. You have not yet faced the true nature of Malugia... so you can be intoxicated by this small sense of victory.”
Jin already knew that the Origin Stone was not functioning properly. The close-quarters battle began, and Jin did not take a single step back, pushing Kelliark back.

The spatial explosions he prided himself on and the Zipple's secret grand magics could not threaten Jin. Not because they weren't of the same Genesis Knight level, but because Jin knew all of it too well.

“Do not try to hide your miserable inner self, Kelliark. Just as I know your power well, you also know me well. I am a person who does not disappear. Whatever you bastards do, whatever the bastards stronger than you are plotting, I am a person who always fights from the same place.”
Feeling the sensation of the blade grazing his neck, Kelliark mulled over the words Jin had just said. It was a statement he could not deny.
While a deafening roar spread as their two weapons clashed, intense explosions continued outside.
[Young Patriarch. The Golden Fleet has just arrived.]
The Golden Fleet that had been on standby in Tikan had arrived. With Dante's safety also secured, there was no longer a single reason for the coalition to be dragged around.
The enraged golden ships were already surrounding the battlefield. There was no escape route for the Tower of Story.
“Flagship Sarah, open the sword. All fleets, annihilate the enemy. On this day, on this land, the Zipple and the Tower of Tales will disappear.”
